decks.name: LeetCode #50 - Pow(x, n)
decks.description: Implement power function to calculate x raised to the power n

cards.question: Pow(x, n): Implement pow(x, n), which calculates x raised to the power n (i.e., x^n).

solutions.name: Binary Exponentiation (Iterative)
solutions.explanation: Use binary exponentiation to reduce the number of multiplications from n to log n. Check each bit of the exponent from right to left. If the bit is set, multiply the result by the current base. Square the base at each step and shift the exponent right. Most efficient solution with constant space.

solutions.timeDescription: Logarithmic time as we halve the exponent at each iteration by right shifting, resulting in log n iterations
solutions.spaceDescription: Constant extra space as we only use a few variables regardless of input size
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given x=2.0, n=10 (binary: 1010): power=10. Iteration 1: bit 0 is 0, skip multiply, x=4.0, power=5 (101). Iteration 2: bit 0 is 1, res=4.0, x=16.0, power=2 (10). Iteration 3: bit 0 is 0, skip, x=256.0, power=1 (1). Iteration 4: bit 0 is 1, res=1024.0, power=0. Result: 1024.0 which is 2^10.

solutions.name: Binary Exponentiation (Recursive)
solutions.explanation: Recursively calculate power using divide and conquer. For each recursive call, square the base and halve the exponent. If exponent is odd, multiply result by base once more. Has logarithmic time complexity but uses recursion stack space.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: Multiply x by itself n times using a simple loop. Handle negative exponents by taking the reciprocal of the result. Simple to understand but inefficient for large exponents as it requires n multiplications.
